world.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
world.description: The US has not confirmed the Ukrainian president's comments - a US official told the BBC "many ideas continue to be discussed".

world.title: Copper wire upgrade behind US flight suspension, transport secretary says
world.description: The US government is trying to find out whether the chaos was caused by "incompetence" or faulty equipment.

world.title: Pope Leo speaks of community 'suffering' on visit to remote Andes town
world.description: Santa Cruz de Succhabamba is part of the Diocese of Chiclayo, where the pope served as bishop from 2015 to 2023.

world.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from closing Washington DC golf course for renovation
world.description: It is the latest development in a months-long challenge to the US president's plans for East Potomac Golf Links.

world.title: Fifth Canadian soldier dies from injuries caused by large fire at military base
world.description: Pte William Douglas Dal Bianco died from his injuries on Friday, a month after a fire that tore through CFB Wainwright.

world.title: Israel kills Hamas commander in strike on Gaza camp, officials say
world.description: Both Hamas and IDF officials confirm the death of Samir Abu Younis, commander of the Rafah Brigade.

world.title: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
world.description: Front-runner Carmelle emerges victorious with her women's empowerment anthem Sobra-Sobra.

world.title: New Orleans port files $1m lawsuit over 'miracle on the Mississippi' tanker collision
world.description: The lawsuit filed by New Orleans officials also requests that the tanker involved in the collision with the cruise ship be seized and sold to pay for damages.

world.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
world.description: The social media giant is accused of not informing 20 million users it had access to their photos.

world.title: Sotheby's auction of $180m Van Gogh challenged over claims it was 'sold under duress'
world.description: Sotheby's says it will work with the heirs of a family who had previously owned the artwork to try and reach a solution.

world.description: Prime Minister Péter Magyar promised a sweeping anti-corruption drive after ousting Orbán in April.

world.title: Nigeria cautions against travel via Ethiopia's main airport due to altitude
world.description: The foreign ministry in Abuja says 6 Nigerians with underlying health problems have died this year while transiting through Addis Ababa.

world.description: SpaceX has performed the historic catch using mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

world.title: Watch: Cruise ship overturns after collision with tanker in New Orleans
world.description: Around 130 people were rescued from a cruise ship after it was struck by a tanker while docked in New Orleans,  Louisiana on Friday.

US.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from moving ahead on Washington public golf course redevelopment
US.description: A federal judge on Saturday ordered a two-week delay to any work at a historic Washington public golf course not far from the White House.

US.title: FAA ground stop disrupts college football
US.description: Some college football games were delayed a few hours on Saturday or postponed to Sunday. And in Oklahoma at least, there will be perks for fans to make up for the inconvenience, including cheap beers.

US.title: Florida city cancels St. Patrick's Day parade, citing new anti-DEI law
US.description: A new Florida law that prohibits taxpayer dollars from going toward diversity initiatives has prompted Delray Beach to cancel its St. Patrick's Day parade after a nearly 60-year run.

US.title: Maintenance gone awry caused nation-wide ground stop, says Transportation Secretary
US.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy points blame toward contractor in explaining Friday's nation-wide aviation ground stop.

US.title: US has lost measles elimination status, global health authorities say
US.description: The U.S. has lost its status as a country where measles is eliminated, according to researchers with direct knowledge of the deliberations at the Pan American Health Organization.

US.title: SpaceX successfully catches Starship and makes history
US.description: The company's spacecraft returned to its Texas launchpad in dramatic fashion — by carefully lowering itself until two metal arms attached to the launch tower could secure it.

US.description: Democrats from across the country descended on Denver for a two-day conference to chart the course of their party after sweeping victories in the midterm elections.

US.title: FAA blames Friday's ground stop on 'equipment issue' during telecoms network upgrade
US.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said initial investigations pointed to an issue with contractor L3Harris updating old tech at a remote location.

US.title: Fuel crisis and protests pressure Chile's far-right president
US.description: Chile's far-right President José Antonio Kast is facing mounting public anger, as rising fuel prices trigger transport strikes and protests across the country.
